steps.message:
# Several things look wrong in a race recording

I recorded a short race (`recording.mp4`) and several things in it don't look the way they
normally do in this game.

Some of what a vehicle carries, or has carried, is drawn or hidden wrongly compared with that
vehicle (it can show through something that covers the vehicle, instead of being hidden with
it, and its effects can be off too), some shadows
don't fall or turn like the others in the clip, and the race view sometimes shows more of the
road behind the vehicle it follows than ahead of it. Which things, when, and what they should
look like instead can be seen in the recording: the same kind of thing is drawn correctly
elsewhere in the same clip.

Please fix all problems. Apart from these, the track layout and the vehicles' movement in
the recording are correct and should keep looking the way they do now.

## Attached visual evidence

The recording is at `/app/.harbor_assets/recording.mp4`.

Inspect the attached video before making changes. You can pull individual frames out of it with
`ffmpeg`.

arguments.command: cd /app; git log --oneline|head; ls; find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' | grep -v node_modules | head -100; ffprobe .harbor_assets/recording.mp4 2>&1 | tail -5

steps.message:
I couldn't watch the recording: `/app/.harbor_assets/` is empty and `recording.mp4` isn't anywhere on the system. So these fixes come from reading the drawing code, finding each kind of object that behaves differently from others of the same kind, and making it match. The code compiles and the core tests pass, but I haven't run the game to check the fixes on screen.

**1. Carried missile showing through things that cover the vehicle** (`bonus/Missile.java`)
A missile still attached to its vehicle was drawn on the topmost layer, above the bridges and tunnels that are drawn over the road. It now goes on the same layer as its vehicle. It also gets the vehicle's colour now, so it fades with the vehicle when the vehicle falls into water. Previously only the mine did that. Once fired, the missile still flies on the top layer as before.

**2. Carried mine** (`bonus/Mine.java`)
I applied the same idea to a mine attached to a vehicle:
- When the vehicle is lifted into the air, the mine goes up with it instead of staying below.
- Its shadow sits at the vehicle's height.
- Its shadow is hidden while the vehicle is falling, just as the vehicle's own shadow is.

Dropped mines are unchanged.

**3. Shadows**
- **Direction** (`racer/VehicleRenderer.java`): vehicle shadows fell up and to the left. Every other shadow (obstacles, bonus boxes, mines, missiles, the helicopter, menu screens) falls down and to the right. Vehicle shadows now do too.
- **Rotation** (`utils/BodyRegionDrawer.java`): shadows of obstacles, bonus boxes, mines and missiles were given their angle in radians where degrees were expected. They barely turned as the object turned, while the object itself turned normally. They now turn with it.

**4. Camera showing more road behind than ahead** (`racescreen/RacerCameraUpdater.java`)
The camera's look-ahead offset pointed in a mirrored direction, so it often sat behind the vehicle. It now points along the vehicle's heading. I also fixed the step that limits how fast the camera can move: it ran after the new position had already been set, so it had no effect.

Track layout and vehicle movement code are untouched. If you can make the recording available, I can check these fixes against it frame by frame.
